# XFreedom

Production-oriented XFreedom client builds from this repository.

> Android APK/AAB, Windows, macOS and Linux artifacts are generated by CI. Store/TestFlight publication requires the corresponding release signing credentials.

| Platform | Artifact |
| --- | --- |
| Android Universal | [XFreedom-Android-universal.apk](https://github.com/aima666qs-commits/xservis-app/releases/download/RELEASE_TAG/XFreedom-Android-universal.apk) |
| Android ARM64 | [XFreedom-Android-arm64.apk](https://github.com/aima666qs-commits/xservis-app/releases/download/RELEASE_TAG/XFreedom-Android-arm64.apk) |
| Android ARMv7 | [XFreedom-Android-arm7.apk](https://github.com/aima666qs-commits/xservis-app/releases/download/RELEASE_TAG/XFreedom-Android-arm7.apk) |
| Android x86_64 | [XFreedom-Android-x86_64.apk](https://github.com/aima666qs-commits/xservis-app/releases/download/RELEASE_TAG/XFreedom-Android-x86_64.apk) |
| Android Play bundle | [xfreedom-android-market.aab](https://github.com/aima666qs-commits/xservis-app/releases/download/RELEASE_TAG/xfreedom-android-market.aab) |
| Windows installer | [XFreedom-Windows-Setup-x64.exe](https://github.com/aima666qs-commits/xservis-app/releases/download/RELEASE_TAG/XFreedom-Windows-Setup-x64.exe) |
| Windows portable | [XFreedom-Windows-Portable-x64.zip](https://github.com/aima666qs-commits/xservis-app/releases/download/RELEASE_TAG/XFreedom-Windows-Portable-x64.zip) |
| macOS DMG | [XFreedom-MacOS.dmg](https://github.com/aima666qs-commits/xservis-app/releases/download/RELEASE_TAG/XFreedom-MacOS.dmg) |
| macOS PKG | [XFreedom-MacOS-Installer.pkg](https://github.com/aima666qs-commits/xservis-app/releases/download/RELEASE_TAG/XFreedom-MacOS-Installer.pkg) |
| Linux AppImage | [XFreedom-Linux-x64-AppImage.AppImage](https://github.com/aima666qs-commits/xservis-app/releases/download/RELEASE_TAG/XFreedom-Linux-x64-AppImage.AppImage) |
| Linux AppImage archive | [XFreedom-Linux-x64-AppImage.tar.gz](https://github.com/aima666qs-commits/xservis-app/releases/download/RELEASE_TAG/XFreedom-Linux-x64-AppImage.tar.gz) |
| Debian x64 | [XFreedom-Debian-x64.deb](https://github.com/aima666qs-commits/xservis-app/releases/download/RELEASE_TAG/XFreedom-Debian-x64.deb) |

The XFreedom VPN/tunnel runtime remains separate from presentation/theme changes. Release signing keys are not stored in source code.
